Name: Post-Marriage Spouse Shared Kitchen and Meta Dialogue Mod
Author: Aquaasa
Description:

添加Meta内容，作为前置mod现与部分角色mod兼容。 如需定制Meta对话或者伴侣对话可移步https://ifdian.net/a/Aquaasa


如果出现放不进去东西的现象重新下载一下mod 最开始错上传成初版mod了

新增高价食品保护，设置5000以上即可保护你的魔法糖冰棍不被吃掉（）

适配mod新增多个对话键名，详情参考具体角色mod

[b]Post-Marriage Shared Kitchen Mod[/b]
[i](Compatible with the in-game fridge; purchased fridges also work.)[/i]
[line]
[b]Overview[/b]
When enabled, your spouse/roommate will take food from the fridge to eat for their three daily meals. If they don’t find anything to eat or nothing they like, there is a chance they will complain during dialogue.
[line]
[b]Meta / Prerequisites[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod requires the [b]Meta[/b] framework as a前置 mod (dependency).[/*]
[*]It is now compatible with certain character mods (see the list below).[/*]
[*][b]Important:[/b] If you encounter issues placing items into the fridge, please re‑download the mod. The initial upload was accidentally the old/initial version – this has been fixed.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]New Feature – High‑Value Food Protection[/b]
A new safeguard has been added: you can set a price threshold (e.g., 5,000 gold or above). Items above that value – such as your [b]Magic Sugar Ice Pops[/b] – will be protected and will not be eaten by your NPC.
[line]
[b]Dialogue Compatibility[/b]
Multiple new dialogue keys have been added for modded NPCs. For full details, please refer to the specific character mod pages.
[line]
[b]NEW – Give Your Spouse/Roommate an Allowance[/b]
Now you can give your partner money so they can go shopping for their own favourite foods.
[list]
[*][b]New fridge option:[/b] [i]“Give money to spouse/roommate”[/i] – available anytime, no need to wait for a complaint dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]Selectable amounts (configurable):[/b] 200 / 520 / 5200 / 6666 / 8888 / 20,000 gold.[/*]
[*][b]Taste‑driven shopping:[/b] NPCs will prioritise buying their most loved or liked items; expensive items are preferred when budget allows.[/*]
[*][b]Quality system:[/b] With sufficient budget, they can buy Iridium‑, Gold‑, or Silver‑quality food.[/*]
[*][b]Magic Sugar Ice Pop:[/b] If the budget is enough, the NPC will buy one [b]for the player[/b] each week (limited to once per week).[/*]
[*][b]Special 6666 Easter egg:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Vanilla NPCs[/i] will be startled and refuse the money.[/*]
[*][i]Modded NPCs[/i] can have custom acceptance dialogues (if the mod author provides them).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Purchase vs. Meal Logs[/b]
[list]
[*]Shopping records are displayed in [b]bright/light colour[/b].[/*]
[*]Meal consumption records are shown in [b]darker colour[/b] – making them easy to distinguish.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Compatible Character Mods (with custom dialogue support)[/b]
This mod now has special dialogue integration for:
[list]
Fyodor(Фёдор) modFlamebringer (炎客) modDuq'arael(血魔大君) modAefanyl(哀珐尼尔) modQui'sartustaj(奎萨图什塔) modPhantom (傀影) mod[/list][i](More character mods may be added in future updates.)[/i]
